chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from Abdullah ibn Jundab, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about the meat of buffaloes and their milk, so he said: There is no problem with them.
ai.seo_question: Is buffalo meat and milk halal in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the permissibility (jawaaz) of consuming buffalo meat and milk, a ruling particularly significant in Shia jurisprudence given the historical presence of buffaloes in Iraq and Iran. The chain of narration via Safwan al-Jarrah highlights the reliability of this transmission within the Usuli school, confirming that buffalo are treated similarly to cattle (al-baqar) regarding dietary laws.
